US-Iran Tensions Escalate in Gulf Region Amidst Retaliation

Tensions in the Gulf region have intensified following renewed US strikes and subsequent Iranian retaliation. Iran has reportedly attacked military targets and infrastructure in Kuwait and Jordan, while also threatening to disrupt key shipping lanes like the Bab el-Mandeb. The escalating conflict raises concerns about regional stability and its global economic impact.
